subject: Vega-Lite 14B onboarding: temporary version escrow & integration questions
messages:
From: Ben Smith <ben.smith@acme-health.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vega-Lite 14B - early onboarding request

Hi Karthik / team,

Following our demo last week, the engineering team here at Acme Health is keen to try Vega-Lite 14B in a staged environment. We have two quick asks up front: a temporary version escrow (we'd like to pin the runtime to a specific Vega-Lite 14B hash for our initial integration) and some basic compatibility notes for tokenization and kv-cache behavior.

Can Redwood provide a short compatibility checklist and confirm whether an escrowed variant is possible for a 2-week integration window? Our primary concern is behavior differences for medical-code-preserving tokenization and latency on short prompt bursts (<=64 tokens).

I attached a very small micro-benchmark we ran locally (vega14b-quick-benchmarks.csv) and a short integration plan. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Smith
ML Platform Lead, Acme Health

Attachments: vega14b-quick-benchmarks.csv, integration-runbook-v0.3.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Smith <ben.smith@acme-health.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vega-Lite 14B - early onboarding request

Ben —

Thanks for the note and the artifacts. Quick replies:
- Temporary escrow: we can provision a pinned variant for a short window, but there are a few guardrails (compat checks, safety scan, and a canary routing policy).
- Tokenizer/kv-cache: Vega-Lite 14B uses a slightly updated tokenizer (v3) vs older Vega releases. We'll surface any tokenization diffs; kv-cache behavior is consistent but we need to validate prefix caching for short burst patterns.

I'm looping in Laura (product) and Monica (serving/runtime) to enumerate the exact compatibility checklist and to propose the escrow window.

Can we schedule a 30min sync tomorrow morning to go over the checklist and timelines?

—Karthik
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Smith <ben.smith@acme-health.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T11:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vega-Lite 14B - early onboarding request

Thanks Ben — high level plan from product:

1) Compatibility checklist (what we will deliver by EOD today):
   - Tokenizer diffs (v2 -> v3) with examples for medical code tokens
   - KV cache semantics and expected latency profile for <=64 token bursts
   - Known variance in token-level logits (approx magnitude)
2) Escrow proposal: 14-calendar-day pinned variant with automatic expiration unless extended by mutual consent.
3) Acceptance criteria for rollback: if top-1 mortality (safety) or latency > 150ms p50 for production-like requests, we will revert to the previous sanctioned variant.

Monica — can your team validate the magic numbers and whether a 14-day escrow is operationally feasible given our autoscaling/capacity policies? Evelyn — I want to confirm legal/controls for temporary variant escrow (audit trail, keying).

Ben — are there specific HIPAA-related constraints on audit logs or variant persistence we should be aware of? If yes, please call them out.

Laura
Director, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Smith <ben.smith@acme-health.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vega-Lite 14B - early onboarding request

We can do a provisional pin for 14 days. Operational notes:
- We'll provision a variant tag (vega-lite-14b:escrow-20271121) routed only to Acme's account and a staging pool.
- Autoscaling: ephemeral capacity will be allocated from a staging pool with warm instances; cold-start tail latency should be < 250ms for short bursts in the staging region (us-west-2).
- Telemetry: we'll enable request/response diffs and token-level logs for the escrow window. Access to raw token logs requires an approval from security.

Two asks for Acme:
1) Provide a representative prompt set (5–10 typical prompts, redacted for PHI) so we can run sample comparisons.
2) Confirm whether you need cross-region replication for the escrowed variant.

I'll kick off a compatibility run against your micro-benchmarks and attach an initial report.

Monica
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vega-compat-checklist-v1.md
From: Ben Smith <ben.smith@acme-health.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-22T08:09:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vega-Lite 14B - early onboarding request

Thanks — quick answers:
- HIPAA: yes, we need an audit trail for model variant selection and access to token-level diffs for a limited set of redacted prompts; we'll sign the access agreement if necessary.
- Prompt set: attached a 7-prompt redacted sample called acme_vega_prompts_redacted.txt (will provide via secure link).
- Cross-region: not necessary for the test window; us-west only is fine.

Can we still aim to start the escrowed variant on Monday (2027-11-24)? We'll want a short dry-run on Friday to sanity-check latencies.

Ben
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Smith <ben.smith@acme-health.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-23T15:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vega-Lite 14B - early onboarding request

Ben —

All set. Summary and action items:
- Monica will run the compatibility suite against your attached prompts and share the initial report by EOD Friday (2027-11-24 17:00 PT).
- We will provision the pinned variant for a 14-day escrow starting Monday 2027-11-27 (target start time 09:00 PT).
- Evelyn will coordinate the audit/access agreement for token-level diffs; legal will send the form by Monday morning.
- Product will prepare a rollback runbook and specific latency/SLO thresholds.

If anything changes before Friday, please flag it in this thread. Otherwise, Monica — go ahead and queue the compatibility run.

Thanks everyone,
Karthik
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
